title: Hard to find the feature to set per-applet keyboard shortcuts for applets that don't expose the functionality in their own config windows
line: The System Tray's Keyboard Shortcuts page now lists every tray entry, so each one's shortcut can be set there.
explanation: Every widget's settings get a shared Keyboard Shortcuts page, but tray entries whose Configure button opens a KCM or their own dialog (Networks, Audio Volume, Clipboard, ...) never show it. Their shortcut was only settable from a column on the tray's General page, which users don't find. The shared page now also lists, for widgets embedded in another one (System Tray, and the grouping widget), every contained widget with its own shortcut field, sorted by name, saved with Apply/OK like the widget's own shortcut.

commits.message:
desktoppackage: list System Tray entries on its Keyboard Shortcuts page

Entries of the System Tray whose Configure button opens a KCM or their
own dialog had their shortcut only on the tray's General page, which is
hard to find. The page now also lists every entry with its own shortcut.

BUG: 479364

patches.diff:
From 6b89d8f077374b2cc10b7a91927c2690148ba570 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 21:02:12 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] desktoppackage: list System Tray entries on its Keyboard
 Shortcuts page

Entries of the System Tray whose Configure button opens a KCM or their
own dialog had their shortcut only on the tray's General page, which is
hard to find. The page now also lists every entry with its own shortcut.

BUG: 479364
---
 .../configuration/ConfigurationShortcuts.qml  | 37 ++++++++++++++++++-
 1 file changed, 36 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/ConfigurationShortcuts.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/ConfigurationShortcuts.qml
index cb15923aaf..5c9304e978 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/ConfigurationShortcuts.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/ConfigurationShortcuts.qml
@@ -7,6 +7,7 @@
 import QtQuick
 import org.kde.kquickcontrols
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+import org.kde.plasma.core as PlasmaCore
 import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 import org.kde.kcmutils as KCM
 
@@ -17,8 +18,23 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
 
     property bool unsavedChanges: false
 
+    readonly property var containedApplets: Plasmoid.containmentType === PlasmaCore.Containment.CustomEmbedded
+        ? Plasmoid.applets.slice().sort((a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title))
+        : []
+
+    function updateUnsavedChanges() {
+        unsavedChanges = button.keySequence !== Plasmoid.globalShortcut
+            || containedApplets.some((applet, i) => appletShortcuts.itemAt(i)?.keySequence !== applet.globalShortcut)
+    }
+
     function saveConfig() {
         Plasmoid.globalShortcut = button.keySequence
+        containedApplets.forEach((applet, i) => {
+            const item = appletShortcuts.itemAt(i)
+            if (item) {
+                applet.globalShortcut = item.keySequence
+            }
+        })
         unsavedChanges = false
     }
 
@@ -29,7 +45,26 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
             Kirigami.FormData.label: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@action:button set keyboard shortcut for", "Activate widget as if clicked:")
             keySequence: Plasmoid.globalShortcut
             patterns: ShortcutPattern.Modifier | ShortcutPattern.ModifierAndKey
-            onKeySequenceModified: root.unsavedChanges = keySequence !== Plasmoid.globalShortcut
+            onKeySequenceModified: root.updateUnsavedChanges()
+        }
+
+        Kirigami.Separator {
+            visible: root.containedApplets.length > 0
+            Kirigami.FormData.isSection: true
+            Kirigami.FormData.label: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@title:group keyboard shortcuts of the widgets inside this one", "Activate entry as if clicked")
+        }
+
+        Repeater {
+            id: appletShortcuts
+            model: root.containedApplets
+
+            KeySequenceItem {
+                required property var modelData
+                Kirigami.FormData.label: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@label %1 is the name of a widget", "%1:", modelData.title)
+                keySequence: modelData.globalShortcut
+                patterns: ShortcutPattern.Modifier | ShortcutPattern.ModifierAndKey
+                onKeySequenceModified: root.updateUnsavedChanges()
+            }
         }
     }
 }
--
